title: Typst test helpers now copy-pasted in three test files — the r1-deferred extraction propagated a third copy inside the r1-fix itself
evidence:
ai_integration_test.gleam:1314-1318 (new in this diff): "@external(erlang, "ai@audit_report_ffi", "available")
fn typst_available() -> Bool

@external(erlang, "ai@audit_report_ffi", "normalize_metadata")
fn normalize_metadata(bytes: BitArray) -> BitArray" — identical bindings already exist in audit_report_test.gleam:36-37,350-351 and pdf_prebake_test.gleam:327-331, and near-identical skip_if_no_typst/priv_dir bodies in audit_report_test.gleam:19-42 and pdf_prebake_test.gleam:310-335. server/test/test_helpers.gleam already exists as the shared helper module.
detail: AGENTS.md: "extract helpers when logic repeats 2+ places." The deferral's predicted cost materialized immediately: the B1 fix added the third copy. A skip-policy or normalizer change now edits three files in lockstep.
recommended_fix: Extract typst_available, normalize_metadata, priv_dir, and skip_if_no_typst (panic message as argument) into test/test_helpers.gleam; import from all three test modules.

title: audit_report_test.gleam comment still documents the removed cover `place` mechanism the W1 fix deleted — it contradicts the template's own "Do NOT re-add it" warning
detail: The W1 fix removed the explicit cover place and corrected the template comment, but left the disproven mechanism documented in the test file. It invites exactly the regression the template forbids.
recommended_fix: Update the comment in audit_report_test.gleam to describe the background-only mechanism (page background renders above the cover block); drop the stale parenthetical.

title: Test-only normalize_metadata/1 remains exported from the production FFI module, and its consumer-list comment is already stale
evidence: ai@audit_report_ffi.erl:8: "-export([compile/3, available/0, normalize_metadata/1])." — repo-wide grep shows zero production callers; only the three test files bind the external. FFI comment line 31: "%% payload. Used by the golden byte-identity pins in audit_report_test.gleam" (line 32: "%% and pdf_prebake_test.gleam.") — omits the new ai_integration_test.gleam consumer.
detail: Test-support code widens the production module's surface, and the hand-maintained consumer list rotted within one round — a direct symptom of the un-extracted helper (see duplication warning).
recommended_fix: As part of the shared test-support extraction, move normalize_metadata behind a test-facing module (or a public audit_report helper) and drop the stale consumer list from the FFI comment.
